topic: no tap-to-call button on an HVAC site
hook: Your AC quit at 4 PM and your HVAC site wants 11 answers first.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll check your site for free, then DM you the first 3 things I'd fix.

July, 4 PM. The AC quit and the house in Phoenix is at 88 and climbing. Nobody in that house wants to type an address into a 6-box form and wait.

They want to tap and hear a person.

If your HVAC site hides the phone behind a Contact page, they tap the next listing on Google instead. Put the number at the top. Make it 1 tap.

#hvac #hvacbusiness #contractor

topic: website looks closed to storm customers
hook: Your website is telling customers you're closed.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll tell you if your site looks closed. Free, no pitch.

Mike is made up. The problem is not. I open roofing sites every week from Texas to Ohio and see the same 3 things: tiny text, no tap-to-call button, a layout from 2009.

A homeowner with a leak gives your site about 5 seconds. If it looks closed, they call the next roofer on Google.

#roofing #roofer #contractor

topic: slow site loses the 2 AM burst pipe call
hook: 2 AM. Water pouring through her kitchen ceiling.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll test how fast your site opens on a phone. Free.

Dan and Sarah are made up. The 2 AM search is real. A pipe bursts in Tampa, she opens 2 plumbers on Google, and the first site that loads with a call button gets the job.

The slow one never even hears about it.

#plumbing #plumber #contractor

topic: free repo that makes Claude plan, test and debug first
hook: Your Claude jumps straight into code. That's why it keeps breaking things.
caption:
Comment POWER and I'll DM you the repo plus my setup guide. Follow first so the DM doesn't land in requests.

Most of us use Claude like a fast intern: it jumps into code, writes 14 files, then 3 tests fail. This free GitHub repo changes the order. It asks questions first, writes a plan, writes the test before the code, then checks its own work.

I use it every day. It's free and open source.

#claudeai #claudecode #aitools
